findings.quoted_text: Upon delivery of each Milestone, Developer assigns to Client all right, title, and interest, including copyrights and patent rights, in and to the custom software code, database schemas, and visual assets developed under this Agreement.

Upon delivery of each Milestone, Developer assigns to Client all right, title, and interest, including copyrights and patent rights, in and to the custom software code, database schemas, and visual assets developed under this Agreement.
findings.explanation: You transfer ownership of the code and assets as soon as you deliver each milestone, even if the client has not yet paid, leaving you without a security interest if they default.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the custom software code, database schemas, and visual assets shall transfer to the Client upon Developer's receipt of payment for the corresponding Milestone.

findings.quoted_text: Client shall pay each milestone within ninety (90) days after Client's final acceptance of the complete Software.
findings.explanation: The client can wait up to 90 days after final acceptance before paying, which creates a long cash‑flow gap for you.
findings.suggested_change: Client shall pay each Milestone within thirty (30) days after receipt of an invoice for that Milestone.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you’re well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a minor amendment to clarify the timing of ownership transfer.

- The relevant clause currently says that ownership of the custom software code, database schemas, and visual assets passes to the Client upon delivery of each Milestone. To protect both parties, I propose that ownership transfers to the Client only after the Developer receives payment for the corresponding Milestone.

Please let me know if this adjustment works for you. Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
